questions.subject: math
questions.prompt: Which team won the most matches at the Summer Olympics?
questions.sourceFact: USA wins=40, China wins=38, Japan wins=27, Great Britain wins=22
questions.explanation: USA had 40 wins, China had 38, Japan had 27, and Great Britain had 22. The biggest number is 40, so USA won the most matches.

questions.subject: math
questions.prompt: China scored 88 goals and Japan scored 58 goals. What is the average number of goals these two teams scored?
questions.explanation: Add the two teams' goals: 88 + 58 = 146. Then divide by 2 because there are 2 teams: 146 ÷ 2 = 73.
